+import pytest
+
+from jinja2 import DictLoader
+from jinja2 import Environment
+from jinja2.ext import Extension
+
+
+def test_overlay_globals_snapshot():
+    parent = Environment()
+    shared = {"items": []}
+    parent.globals.update(value="initial", parent_drop=1, overlay_drop=2, shared=shared)
+    before = dict(parent.globals)
+    overlay = parent.overlay()
+    assert overlay.globals == before
+    assert overlay.globals is not parent.globals
+
+    parent.globals["value"] = "parent"
+    parent.globals["parent_only"] = 3
+    del parent.globals["parent_drop"]
+    assert overlay.globals["value"] == "initial"
+    assert "parent_only" not in overlay.globals
+    assert overlay.globals["parent_drop"] == 1
+
+    overlay.globals["value"] = "overlay"
+    overlay.globals["overlay_only"] = 4
+    del overlay.globals["overlay_drop"]
+    assert parent.globals["value"] == "parent"
+    assert "overlay_only" not in parent.globals
+    assert parent.globals["overlay_drop"] == 2
+
+    overlay.globals["shared"]["items"].append("overlay")
+    parent.globals["shared"]["items"].append("parent")
+    assert overlay.globals["shared"] is shared
+    assert shared["items"] == ["overlay", "parent"]
+    overlay.globals["shared"] = {"items": ["replacement"]}
+    assert parent.globals["shared"] is shared
+
+    child = overlay.overlay()
+    overlay.globals["value"] = "later"
+    assert child.globals["value"] == "overlay"
+    child.globals["child_only"] = True
+    assert "child_only" not in overlay.globals
+    assert "child_only" not in parent.globals
+
+
+def test_overlay_template_globals_ownership():
+    source = "{{ value }}|{{ extra|default('-') }}"
+    parent = Environment(loader=DictLoader(dict.fromkeys(["early", "local", "late"], source)))
+    parent.globals["value"] = "initial"
+    early = parent.get_template("early")
+    local = parent.get_template("local", globals={"value": "parent-local"})
+    string = parent.from_string(source)
+    overlay = parent.overlay()
+    other_early = overlay.get_template("early")
+    other_local = overlay.get_template("local", globals={"value": "overlay-local"})
+    other_string = overlay.from_string(source)
+    assert other_early is not early
+    assert early.render() == other_early.render() == "initial|-"
+
+    parent.globals.update(value="parent", extra="P")
+    overlay.globals.update(value="overlay", extra="O")
+    late = parent.get_template("late")
+    other_late = overlay.get_template("late")
+    parent_plain = [early, string, late]
+    overlay_plain = [other_early, other_string, other_late]
+    for template in parent_plain:
+        assert template.render() == "parent|P"
+    for template in overlay_plain:
+        assert template.render() == "overlay|O"
+    assert local.render() == "parent-local|P"
+    assert other_local.render() == "overlay-local|O"
+
+    assert parent.get_template("local", globals={"value": "updated-parent"}) is local
+    assert overlay.get_template("local", globals={"value": "updated-overlay"}) is other_local
+    assert local.render() == "updated-parent|P"
+    assert other_local.render() == "updated-overlay|O"
+    assert parent.globals["value"] == "parent"
+    assert overlay.globals["value"] == "overlay"
+    assert early.render() == "parent|P"
+    assert other_early.render() == "overlay|O"
+    assert other_local.render(value="render", extra="R") == "render|R"
+
+    parent.globals["value"] = "parent-new"
+    del parent.globals["extra"]
+    for template in parent_plain:
+        assert template.render() == "parent-new|-"
+    for template in overlay_plain:
+        assert template.render() == "overlay|O"
+    overlay.globals["value"] = "overlay-new"
+    del overlay.globals["extra"]
+    for template in overlay_plain:
+        assert template.render() == "overlay-new|-"
+    assert local.render() == "updated-parent|-"
+    assert other_local.render() == "updated-overlay|-"
+

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("cache_size", [-1, 0, 2])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("override_size", [None, -1, 0, 3])
+def test_overlay_preserves_registries_extensions_and_cache(cache_size, override_size):
+    class Marker(Extension):
+        pass
+
+    parent = Environment(loader=DictLoader({"t": "{{ value }}"}), cache_size=cache_size, extensions=[Marker])
+    parent.globals["value"] = "initial"
+    original = parent.get_template("t")
+    kwargs = {} if override_size is None else {"cache_size": override_size}
+    overlay = parent.overlay(**kwargs)
+    assert overlay.filters is parent.filters
+    assert overlay.tests is parent.tests
+    assert overlay.policies is parent.policies
+    assert overlay.extensions[Marker.identifier] is not parent.extensions[Marker.identifier]
+    assert overlay.extensions[Marker.identifier].environment is overlay
+    assert parent.extensions[Marker.identifier].environment is parent
+    expected_size = cache_size if override_size is None else override_size
+    if expected_size == 0:
+        assert overlay.cache is None
+    else:
+        assert overlay.cache is not parent.cache

+

+    assert original.environment is parent

+    assert original.render() == "initial"
+    if expected_size != 0:
+        assert overlay.get_template("t") is loaded
+    if cache_size != 0:
+        assert parent.get_template("t") is original

spec.question:
Add globals isolation to `Environment.overlay()`. Each new overlay must start with a shallow snapshot of the creating environment's globals: subsequent top-level additions, replacements, and deletions in either environment must not affect the other, but mutable values present at creation must remain shared. This must also hold when creating an overlay from another overlay.

Preserve the existing sharing of filters, tests, and policies, extension rebinding, and independent initially empty template caches, including disabled caches and explicit `cache_size` overrides. Templates loaded in the parent before overlay creation must continue using the parent environment's globals. Templates subsequently created or loaded in either environment must use that environment's live globals as their fallback. Template-specific overrides and updates to cached templates must remain local, and render arguments must keep their existing precedence.

Return a unified diff against the implementation files only; do not change tests.
